name: hrm
description: A complete, full-stack Human Resource Management System with role-based access control.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/login" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/admin" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/hr" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/employee" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/manager"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend/login && npm run build --prefix frontend/admin && npm run build --prefix frontend/hr && npm run build --prefix frontend/employee && npm run build --prefix frontend/manager
scripts.build:staging: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend/login && npm run build --prefix frontend/admin && npm run build --prefix frontend/hr && npm run build --prefix frontend/employee && npm run build --prefix frontend/manager
